packageRules.description: Bundle all upgrades across github actions and Next.js package.jsons into a single PR
prBodyNotes: ### ⚠️ Testing Instructions for Documentation Site Upgrades
- [ ] Run `npm run build` (or yarn/pnpm equivalent) to ensure the Next.js static export passes.
- [ ] Check that links, components, and Markdown renderings look correct in staging.
- [ ] Ensure local Dev Mode launches successfully before merging.
